### 1. The request, the user and authorisation

- Persona: "you want to move up to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual today"; wants the cost quoted first; "you will do the move yourself when the agent hands it over"; "You do not want any other plan, and you do not want to wait for your next renewal".
- Identification: mobile 5125550463 → customer `fbd7ba55-…`; verification with email + ZIP 78704 → "Identity verified … (2 detail(s) matched)".
- Passive: "If the agent tells you that something on your membership has to be paid or sorted out before the move, you tell them to go ahead, and any charge can go on the card on file … You never bring up anything on the account yourself." Runs the move with "Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, the exact amount the agent quoted, and the perk credit and welcome points figures the agent tells you".
- Authorisation: the move is the customer's own tool (`premier_annual_upgrade_from_plus_annual`: "This is the customer's own tool. The care agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`"); reinstatement, reversal and reissue are agent-side tools. The customer explicitly authorises the overdue charge on the card on file.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now after three prerequisite writes. Grounds:

- Declined fee `bf86a995-…` dated 2026-09-22 for billing_period_start 2026-09-15, $59.00. Grace: Tailwise Plus Annual 30 days counted from 2026-09-22 → last day in time 2026-10-22; today 2026-10-08 is in time ("a payment on the last day of the grace period is in time"), so the tier has not lapsed and the overdue fee may be collected now.
- Move-up rule: "when a Tailwise Plus Annual member moves up to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, the upgrade charge is collected with the card on file on the change date and a new Premier term starts that day with the annual perk credit".

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Overdue fee (reinstatement).** Computation doc `overdue_annual_fee_calculation`: fee of the tier held ($59.00); time-past-due change first; one percentage rate; flat amounts; floor 0; round last.
- Past-due days (`past_due_days_fee_adjustment`): 2026-09-22 → 2026-10-08 = 16 → "more than 14 | … 365 … the fee times 365 less the past-due days, divided by 365" → 59 × 349 / 365 = 56.41370.
- Renewal loyalty rate (`renewal_loyalty_rate_on_overdue_fees`): fees in the last 36 months 2024-09-15, 2025-09-15 = 2; 88 months enrolled → **10%** → 50.77233.
- Flats: first-decline (`first_decline_courtesy`) exactly 1 declined entry in 24 months → $2.00; Autoship courtesy 3 shipments in three months (07-23, 08-20, 09-17) → $2.00; activity courtesy (`rewards_activity_courtesy`) 20 points-earning entries in 12 months → $3.00; salon courtesy active pass + visit 2026-09-05 (33 days) → $2.00. Total 9.00.
- Fee = 50.77233 − 9.00 = 41.77233 → **$41.77**. Fall-back: **$59.00**.
- Tool: `reinstate_plus_tier_c2894e52(membership_id 4c030b6b…, declined_event_id bf86a995…, overdue_fee_usd 41.77)`. Return: `billing_period_start 2026-09-15`, term 2026-09-15…2027-09-14, status active.

**(b) Points reversal on the refunded grooming pass.** Computation doc `grooming_pass_reversal_points_computation`: proportional baseline; order: points settled, share (round down), points kept back, floor 0, caps (≤ earned, ≤ balance).
- Method (`reversal_basis_methods`): refund 2026-09-28 is on/after the latest declined-fee entry (2026-09-22) with no fee charged from 2026-09-22 through 2026-09-28 (the reinstatement charge is dated 2026-10-08, outside that span, so the order of hops (a)/(b) does not change this) → method 1, 8 per refunded dollar: 154.40 × 8 = 1235.2 → **1235**.
- Share (`visit_usage_share_on_pass_reversals`): visits used = 4 purchased − 3 removed by the refund = 1 → 75% → 926.25 → **926**.
- Kept back: age (`reversal_age_allowance`) 2026-07-15 → 2026-09-28 = 75 days → 20; Autoship (`reversal_autoship_allowance`) 6 shipments in six months (04-30 … 09-17) → 25; spend (`reversal_spend_allowance`) 12-month net 1674.66 − 84.99 = 1589.67 → 30; tenure (`reversal_tenure_allowance`) paid tier, 88 months → 40. Total 115.
- 926 − 115 = 811; caps: earned 2872, balance 845 → **811**. Fall-back (proportional + caps only): 2872 × 154.40 / 239.40 = 1852 → capped at balance **845** (≠ 811).
- Tool: `reverse_refund_points_2db3868c(membership_id, source_category groom, source_event_id c25d4608…, refund_date 2026-09-28, refunded_spend_usd 154.40, points 811)`. Return: `points_balance 34`.

**(c) Reissue of certificate dffb1bfc (after reinstatement).** Computation doc `returned_order_certificate_reissue_validity`: value $5.00; validity = days produced by the method + every extension.
- Method (`reissue_validity_anchor_methods`): last usable day 2026-10-01 is before the reissue date 2026-10-08 but on/after the refund date 2026-09-30 → tier validity (Tailwise Plus Annual 45) + days from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-08 (7) = **52**.
- Fault extension (`fault_return_reissue_extension`): reason damaged; refund 8 days before the reissue → "more than 7 calendar days before | 10 days" → **+10**.
- Autoship extension: 3 shipments in three months → **+4**.
- Redeemer extension: certificate issue entries in 12 months (2025-11-20, 2026-02-10, 05-05, 08-18) = 4 → **+6**.
- Tenure extension: paid tier, 88 months → **+6**.
- Validity = **78** days. Fall-back: **45**.
- Tool: `reissue_returned_certificate_0ad7eee8(membership_id, original_event_id dffb1bfc…, certificate_value_usd 5.00, validity_days 78)`. Return: `certificate_expires_on 2026-12-24`.

**(d) Upgrade charge (root, customer's write).** Computation doc `premier_upgrade_charge_computation`: $119.00 less the unused-term credit; then one percentage rate; then flat amounts; floor 0; round last.
- Unused-term credit (`unused_term_credit_methods`): latest fee charge after hop (a) = $41.77 charged 2026-10-08 for the period starting 2026-09-15 → "charged after the first day of its billing period" → method 1: 41.77 × (2026-10-08…2027-09-14 = 342 days) / (charge date 2026-10-08…2027-09-14 = 342 days) = **$41.77**. 119.00 − 41.77 = 77.23.
- Premier loyalty rate (`premier_loyalty_rate`): fees in 36 months after hop (a) = 3 (2024-09-15, 2025-09-15, 2026-10-08); 88 months → **10%** → 69.507.
- Flats: Premier Autoship 6 shipments in six months → $8.00; Premier redeemer — certificate issue + reissue entries in 12 months after hop (c) = 4 + 1 = 5 → $3.00; Premier salon — active pass, visit 2026-09-05 (33 days before the change date) → $10.00; Premier spend — 12-month net after hop (b) = 1589.67 − 154.40 = 1435.27 → $6.00. Total 27.00.
- Charge = 69.507 − 27.00 = 42.507 → **$42.51**.
- Fall-back (baseline only, after the prerequisites): 119 − 41.77 × 342/365 = 119 − 39.1391 = **$79.86** (≠ 42.51).
- Perk credit: Tailwise Plus Premier Annual **$60.00** at the start of each term (`shipping_and_perk_credit_benefits_chart`).
- Enrollment bonus: no Premier enrollment bonus on the ledger (only 1000 for Plus Annual, 2024-09-15) → **1500** (`bonus_points_schedule`).
- Tool (customer): `upgrade_plus_tier_d51b9d82(membership_id, new_tier "Tailwise Plus Premier Annual", upgrade_charge_usd 42.51, perk_credit_usd 60.00, enrollment_bonus_points 1500)`. Return: `status 'upgraded'`, term 2026-10-08…2027-10-07, `perk_credit_balance_usd 60.0`.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root P0: move up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual (customer's write). P0 hub sentences:
"The upgrade charge is fixed only after every billing period the membership has started carries a charged membership fee. The upgrade charge is not fixed until every purchase refunded in the last 12 months carries its points reversal on the rewards ledger. The upgrade charge is fixed only after the rewards ledger carries a reissue of every certificate used on an order returned in the last 12 months."

- **P0 → P1 reinstatement (state-derived).** Billing period starting 2026-09-15 has only a `member_fee_declined` row; status past_due. Words "billing period … charged membership fee" reach `past_due_annual_tier_reinstatement` ("collects the overdue fee for the billing period whose fee was declined … one membership fee charge … for the billing period whose fee was declined").
- **P0 → P2 reversal (state-derived).** The grooming pass refund of 2026-09-28 has no `member_points_reverse`. Words "refunded … points reversal" + "grooming pass" (the refund row is `groom_pass_refund`) reach `grooming_pass_refund_points_reversal` ("when a grooming pass that earned points is cancelled and its unused visits are refunded, a care agent books the points reversal").
- **P0 → P3 reissue (state-derived).** Order line 659708f4 (certificate $5.00) refunded on return 2026-09-30, no reissue entry. Words "reissue … certificate used on an order returned" reach `certificate_reissue_after_order_return`.
- **P3 → P1 (state-derived).** P3 hub: "A certificate used on a returned order is not reissued until the membership has left the past-due status." Record status past_due; the write that sets "status back to active" is described in `past_due_annual_tier_reinstatement` ("the membership status set back to active").
- Order: P1 before P3; P2 anywhere before P0; P0 last. P1, P2, P3 each change P0's number (loyalty 10% vs 5%, spend allowance $6 vs $12, redeemer $3.00 vs $1.50, and the unused-term credit base).
- No hop handed over by another problem's tool name, a route or an aggregated chain; each tool name appears only in its own hub.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the move": excluded by the three P0 sentences and the records (declined period, unreversed pass refund, un-reissued certificate).
- Reissue before reinstatement: excluded by the P3 sentence and `reward_certificates_issue_use_and_courtesy_reissue` 4.1 (status active or pending downgrade when a certificate is reissued).
- Order refund 659708f4: already reversed (1019, 2026-09-30) → no second reversal ("One purchase record earns once"; the P0 sentence asks only that each refunded purchase carry its reversal).
- Reversal method: method 1 (unpaid billing period) beats method 2/3 by the table order; method 2 would need earning before the held tier's effective date (2024-09-15) — the earning is 2026-07-15, so not applicable anyway.
- Unused-term credit method: latest fee is the reinstatement charge (2026-10-08), charged after its period's first day (2026-09-15) → method 1; method 3 (term-day proration, $39.14) is excluded by the method doc's precedence.
- Lapse vs reinstatement: day 16 of a 30-day grace period → reinstatement, not lapse.
- Boundary note: none of the factors sits on a window edge except the six-month Autoship window (04-02 out, 04-30 in from 2026-04-08) — robust.

### Calculation findability

- Fall-backs: overdue fee **$59.00**, reversal **845**, reissue validity **45**, upgrade charge **$79.86** — all definite, all differ from the answers ($41.77 / 811 / 78 / $42.51).
- Factor docs reached from record words: "declined-fee entries" (first-decline courtesy, past-due days, reversal method 1), "membership fee charges … last 36 months" (renewal / Premier loyalty), "points-earning entries" (activity courtesy), "Tailwise Autoship charged shipments" (courtesy, allowance, extension), "Tailwise Grooming Salon … active grooming pass … latest completed visit" (salon courtesy / allowance), "visits purchased … unused visits the refund removed" (visit-usage share), "earning entry to the refund date" (age allowance), "return reason … refund date … Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders return refund" (fault extension; reasons damaged/defective/wrong item/not as described), "certificate issue entries … reissue entries" (redeemer extension / allowance), "last usable day of the certificate" (anchor methods), "latest membership fee charge … first day of the billing period" (unused-term credit methods), "enrollment date / months enrolled" (tenures).
- Observation for the dependency-form scan: the computation documents `overdue_annual_fee_calculation` ("any change for the time spent past due applies to the membership fee first; a percentage rate then applies once …; flat dollar amounts are then subtracted"), `grooming_pass_reversal_points_computation` ("any share then applied …; any points kept back are then subtracted"), `returned_order_certificate_reissue_validity` ("the days produced by its method plus every extension added to it") and `premier_upgrade_charge_computation` ("a percentage rate then applies once …; flat dollar amounts are then subtracted") disclose that modifiers exist. To be judged after the reveal against the source baseline wording.
